forum.title: STM32H7B3LIH6Q – TFT RGB selection and HDMI support
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello,

Look at the [STM32H7B3I-EVAL](https://www.st.com/en/evaluation-tools/stm32h7b3i-eval.html) it contains a 7" 800x480 WVGA TFT.

![mALLEm_0-1777536932075.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/06629db5-f6da-a39c-33d6-5c887c1e2d36.png "mALLEm_0-1777536932075.png")

It uses Rocktech LCD, part number: [RK070ER9427-CTG](https://community.st.com/ysqtg83639/attachments/ysqtg83639/mcu-touch-gfx-gui-forum/25441/1/RK070ER9427-CTG.pdf).

For the options you suggested I can't tell. You need to check from your side.

For HDMI you need indeed a HDMI converter. For [ADV7511](https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/adv7511.pdf): I don't know you need to check with its manufacturer: *Analog Device*.

There is a board provided by ST: [DSI to HDMI adapter](https://www.st.com/resource/en/user_manual/um2048-dsi-to-hdmi-adapter-board-for-stm32-development-tools-stmicroelectronics.pdf), but unfortunately STM32H7B3 doesn't have DSI interface. I don't know if there is a LCD-TFT to HDMI converter bridge is available from ST.

Good luck.
forum.content_text:
Hello,

I am using STM32H7B3LIH6Q and planning to interface a TFT display via LTDC (RGB interface). I am considering the following options:

* NHD-4.3-800480CF-ASXP (4.3", 800×480, RGB)

* NHD-4.3-480272EF-ASXP (4.3", 480×272, RGB)

* NHD-3.5-320240JF-ASXP (3.5", 320×240, RGB)

Kindly suggest:

1. Which TFT is most suitable for STM32H7 in terms of performance and ease of integration?

2. Is 800×480 the preferred resolution for LTDC + TouchGFX applications?

3. Do these RGB TFT displays support HDMI interface directly?

4. If HDMI output is required, is using an external RGB-to-HDMI bridge (e.g., ADV7511) the correct approach?

Thanks.
forum.author: vijayajangam
